subject: Request: convert two contractor roles to Senior Platform Engineer (headcount exception)

Subject: Request to convert two contractors to Senior Platform Engineer (headcount exception)

Hi Karthik + Laura —

Quick note to start a thread for a headcount exception I need approved by mid-August. For the past 9 months we have two long-tenured contractors on the runtime team ("Alyssa" and "Tom" — currently under TalentPartners). They are filling senior platform engineering responsibilities: kernel selection work, autoscaling policy plumbing, and a lot of on-call cleanup. Having them as contractors is creating fragility (knowledge loss risk, limited access for some infra systems, and recruiting drag).

Ask: convert both contractor seats into two full-time Senior Platform Engineer headcount (IC4 band) and allow us to extend offers with a small sign-on buffer. Rationale and numbers below: 
- Business impact: sustained ownership of autoscaler, reduced on-call toil (projected 25% fewer SEV wakeups), and faster rollouts for Dedicated customers.
- Timing: ideal offers issued by 2028-08-20 to avoid losing them to other mid-market offers.
- Cost delta: contractors cost ~ $145k each over 6 months; FTE fully-burdened target comp ~ $220k (mid of IC4 band). Incremental annual run-rate delta ~ $75k per head.
- Compensation ask: base + bonus target at $190k-$240k ranges depending on experience; request permission to offer up to $25k sign-on for each in exceptional cases.

I have a short packet attached (org-chart-v2.pdf) and the comp band spreadsheet for reference. This is a runway-critical ask: if we lose them we will need to backfill 6+ months of onboarding.

Please advise next steps — if Finance/PeopleOps need a separate form, I can fill immediately.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Staff Engineering Manager, Runtime

> Quick note to start a thread for a headcount exception I need approved by mid-August...

Soojin — thanks for the clear breakdown. Two quick clarifying items before I route to Marcus and Finance: 
1) Are these net-new headcount (i.e., outside our quota) or a reclassification of existing contractor budget? I think the ask is a net add to the FTE headcount pool and will require an exception.
2) Can you provide a short 3-point onboarding ramp plan and success criteria we can include in the approval memo (how we'll measure the reduction in toil and the delivery milestones for autoscaler work)?

If you can send those two pieces today I will pull this into Marcus' Monday review.

-Karthik

Karthik — thanks. Answers below and attaching comp band sheet (comp-band-senior-platform-2028.xlsx).

1) Headcount classification: this is a net add to the FTE pool. We had contractor budget allocated for Q2-Q3 but there is no earmarked FTE conversion pathway in the current plan. We are requesting two new permanent slots (IC4).

2) Ramp plan & success criteria (short):
- Week 0–8: knowledge transfer & access remediation. Goal: full alerting ownership and >= 80% runbook coverage for the autoscaler stack.
- Week 8–20: feature delivery and operational stability. Goal: complete two autoscaler optimizations and reduce median SEV incident reconciliation time by 30%.
- Month 6: observed reduction in latency spikes under burst traffic and documented SLA improvements for Dedicated customers.

I copied Evelyn from PeopleOps to confirm comp-band constraints and recruiting logistics. Evelyn — can you confirm if the IC4 range listed in the spreadsheet is current and whether a sign-on up to $25k requires an exception?

Thanks,
Soojin

Hi all — FYI on comp bands and PeopleOps process: 

- IC4 Senior Platform Engineer band (effective 2028-07)
  - Base range: $155,000 - $215,000
  - Total cash target (base + target bonus): $180,000 - $250,000
  - Sign-on authority: PeopleOps can approve up to $15,000 on the spot for conversion cases; anything above $15k requires HR Director approval and a short justification memo.

- Process notes: For a headcount exception you need:
  1) Completed headcount request form (HRREQ-4572) — link below (I've prefilled some fields).
  2) Approval from Hiring Manager (Soojin), Eng Dir (Marcus), and FP&A (Rishi).
  3) If sign-on > $15k, HR Director note and Finance confirm.

I uploaded a prefilled HRREQ and left the comp band spreadsheet in the attachments. If you're comfortable with sign-on cap at $15k we can fast-track this through my desk and FP&A next week.

Links: https://docs.redwood.example.com/peopleops/hc-exceptions/2028-08-soojin

-Evelyn

After reviewing the packet and Evelyn's note, I approve the conversion of two contractor seats into two permanent Senior Platform Engineer (IC4) headcount on the following conditions: 
1) Sign-on offers capped at $15,000 per person (PeopleOps approved).
2) Rishi to confirm budget (FP&A) and encode the two FTEs into Q3 headcount forecast (Rishi — please confirm by 2028-08-18).
3) Soojin to complete the HRREQ-4572 form and attach the 6-month ramp plan; PeopleOps will route the offers after FP&A confirmation.

This is priority given the operational risk. If Rishi flags budget constraints we'll explore temporary reallocation within Platform's reserved pool.

Regards,
